New in the archive

Active builds

  • rapp-train — RAPP release-train flight deck — join or test-fly any ring from one page
  • rapp-canary — RAPP release-train canary ring; seeded from the untouched Grail
  • rapterbot.com — RapterBot.com public site and privacy-safe autonomous company DOGG

Rediscovered

Content-addressed file sharing in 200 lines, no servers — Drop a file in the browser. Hash it with SHA-256. Push it via a public-CDN-backed git host. The hash is the URL. Verification is mathematical. No servers, no IPFS, no blockchain.

Lost App → clean-room lesson

Agent Workflow System: A browser-based agent workflow workshop rebuilt as a safe local simulator that treats imported code only as data.

Open the rebuild lesson · Run the local demo

RAPP Vision brief

This abandoned browser app could compose an entire agent workflow without running a single real agent.

How to design a visual agent workflow editor without accidentally building a remote-code execution engine.

Short: Three workflow nodes, zero live agents, one complete local simulation.
